blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.
blocks.zh: Frontier LLMS几乎可以完美无缺地复制随机文本,然而它们常常会被重复字符的长块所超越或被截断. 在重复字符串中,匹配的本地内容不再可靠地识别出应该继续复制或应该停止复制的地方. 尽管如此,我们显示一个带有$O(\log\log N)$-bit精度和$O(\log N/\log\log N)宽度的双层变压器可以复制每个字符串到所选择的设计地平线$N$,并在任意重复的情况下正确终止. 我们使用RoPE风格的注意力值和输出旋转(VO-旋转),以小质期来编码与定界锚的距离来调制这些质地. 根据"中国遗存定理",这些周期编码共同区分出所有需要的距离,允许一个检索规则选择下个源令牌或端标. 相反,我们证明,在相继的有限精度软马克斯堆积下复制是宽度独立的不可能结果。 它适用于唯一的位置输入是最终会变常的添加性注意力偏差的变压器,包括无PE和递归性地执行ALi. 双 一旦一个同键跑超过所产生的饱和阈值,再重复会使对数保持不变. 如果这个阈值用$N$子线性地增长,这些模型既不能完成一个长长的全同式复制,也不能正确停止,这个模式类似于边框 LLMs的终止错误. 在合成复制实验中,即使训练范围内,基线变压器模型也会在长长的重复弦上失败. 相形之下,经过训练的VO型号,一般在训练长度以外,精度接近完美,长度可达约5005美元,即所选的素材期产品.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressively copying text is a fundamental primitive for modern large language models (LLMs).
LLMs copy when they reuse retrieved documents, quote code or data, or transfer a specific answer from a chain of thought into the final response.
Historically, this copying task has motivated explicit pointer or copy mechanisms in sequence models ( Vinyals et al., 2015 ; Gu et al., 2016 ; See et al., 2017 ) .
Meanwhile, transformers seem to learn to copy easily, often through the “induction head” mechanism ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) : they match the already-copied prefix to its earlier occurrence in the prompt and retrieve the subsequent token.
For random sequences, short local contexts uniquely identify the occurrence. Jelassi et al. (2024) formalized this content-addressed mechanism, showing that a two-layer transformer (with a particular position encoding) can copy strings of length ≤ L \leq L with O ⁡ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ L ) O(\log\log L) precision—provided the input contains no repeated n n -grams.
blocks.zh:
自动复制文本是现代大语言模型(LLM)的根本原始.
LLMs在重新使用检索到的文档,引用代码或数据时复制,或者将一个特定答案从一连串的思考中传输到最后的响应中.
历史上,这种复制任务在序列模型中激发出明确的指向或复制机制(Vinyals等,2015;Gu等,2016;See等,2017.).
同时,变压器似乎很容易复制,常常是通过“上岗头”机制(Olsson等人,2022年)复制的:它们与先前出现的变压器在即时复制的前缀相匹配,并取回了后来的代号.
对于随机序列,短的局部上下文独有地识别出发生. Jelassi等人(2024年)将这种内容地址机制正式化,显示一个双层变压器(具有特定位置编码)可以将长度为 Q 的 L\leq L 的字符串与 O + (log Q) (log Q) O(\log\log L) 精度复制,条件是输入中不包含重复的 n-克 。

blocks.en:
Surprisingly, however, removing this non-repetition assumption seems to change the difficulty of copying qualitatively.
As shown in Figure 1 , frontier LLMs that copy random strings near-perfectly sometimes fail catastrophically on strings with long repeated runs of letters, either overgenerating severely or stopping early.
Repetition changes what the task demands: when many positions carry the same local content, matching the already-copied prefix no longer picks out which occurrence to continue from, so the model must tell these occurrences apart by other means.
blocks.zh:
然而,令人惊讶的是,删除这种不重复的假设似乎改变了复制质量的困难。
如图1所示,复制随机字符串的边疆 LLMs 几乎完美地有时会灾难性地在字符串上失败,并重复了很长时间的信件,要么严重地产生过多,要么提早停止。
重复会改变任务的要求:当许多位置带有相同的本地内容时,匹配已经复制的前缀不再选择要继续的发生,所以模型必须用其他方式将这些发生区分开来.

blocks.en:
The answer is yes: for any fixed finite vocabulary and each sufficiently large design horizon N N , a single two-layer transformer can copy every source of length at most N N under arbitrary repetition and terminate correctly, using O ⁡ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ N ) O(\log\log N) -bit precision and O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N / log ⁡ log ​ N ) O(\log N/\log\log N) width.
Our construction uses its first layer to encode each position’s offset relative to delimiters —specifically, its distance to the preceding delimiter ( ⟨ BoS ⟩ \langle\text{{BoS}}\rangle in the source or ⟨ Copy ⟩ \langle\text{{Copy}}\rangle in the copy segment)—so that tokens can be retrieved by position rather than by matching their content.
The need for a delimiter anchor arises because on an all-identical source, attention cannot extract positional signals from the source tokens themselves.
RoPE’s query/key rotations ( Su et al., 2024 ) and ALiBi’s logit biases ( Press et al., 2022 ) change attention weights but leave the source value vectors identical: redistributing a fixed total attention weight among these tokens does not change their contribution to the output.
Position can still affect the output through the weights assigned to special delimiters, such as the beginning-of-source token ⟨ BoS ⟩ \langle\text{{BoS}}\rangle , but only by changing how much of each delimiter’s fixed value enters the output.
By contrast, value/output rotations (VO-RoPE; Su, 2025 ) let position act on the returned vector itself: even when two queries attend entirely to ⟨ BoS ⟩ \langle\text{{BoS}}\rangle , the returned vectors can differ because the rotation encodes each query’s distance from it.

Our first layer applies these rotations with small prime periods (e.g., 2 , 3 , … 2,3,\ldots ) to encode delimiter-relative offsets.

By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, the periods jointly distinguish every offset below their product, so the first layer resolves a long range of offsets with low precision and width.
The second layer then uses these representations to retrieve either the next source token or the end marker, handling copying and termination with one rule.

blocks.en: 1.1 Our Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.1 我们的捐款

blocks.en:
We formalize the expressivity question in a horizon-uniform framework: one model must copy every source of length L ≤ N L\leq N with the same parameters.
Its width, depth, and precision may grow with the design horizon N N , but its parameters cannot specialize to the realized length.
This captures a natural requirement for a model designed for a finite context window, and lies between length-specific circuit expressivity ( Li et al., 2024 ; Merrill & Sabharwal, 2023 ) and fixed-resource expressivity over unbounded lengths ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Copying, for instance, is easy in the circuit model (the next-token map admits linear-size uniform AC 0 \mathrm{AC}^{0} circuits; see Appendix C ), but fixed models also cannot copy inputs of unbounded lengths ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Li & Cotterell, 2025 ) .
By bridging these two regimes, our framework provides a fine-grained lens to quantify the positional representations, bit precision, and width needed for a transformer to copy reliably across all lengths within the horizon.

这捕捉到一种为有限上下文窗口设计的模型的自然要求,并且介于长度特有电路快感(Li等,2024;Merrill & Sabharwal,2023)和无限长度的固定资源快感(Yang等,2025;Yang等,2026)之间.

For any fixed finite vocabulary and all sufficiently large design horizons N N , we construct a two-layer transformer that copies every string of length L ≤ N L\leq N and terminates correctly under arbitrary repetition.
Our VO-rotation instantiates the VO-RoPE operation with a prime-number period per head, using Θ ⁡ ( log ⁡ N / log ⁡ log ​ N ) \Theta(\log N/\log\log N) heads in total.
The construction uses O ⁡ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ N ) O(\log\log N) -bit precision and O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N / log ⁡ log ​ N ) O(\log N/\log\log N) width ( Theorem 3.8 ).
We use small periodic counters to index the rounded rotation tables.

We also prove a width-independent impossibility result for eventually-constant bias-only (ECB) transformers, whose only positional information enters through a pre-softmax additive attention bias that becomes constant beyond some distance.
Under our finite-precision execution model, the analysis covers NoPE ( Kazemnejad et al., 2023 ) , a recursive implementation of ALiBi ( Press et al., 2022 ) , and bounded-window Hard-ALiBi ( Jelassi et al., 2024 ) within this class.
The proof tracks identical-token runs after an arbitrary fixed prefix, layer by layer.
Beyond a certain length, appending another identical token no longer changes the next-token logits.
In copying, a model that emits the required repeated letters then keeps repeating them for as long as the context remains in its domain, a failure pattern resembling the overruns observed in LLMs.
Increasing width does not remove this obstruction: for the instances in Corollary 3.5 , models of depth D ⁡ ( N ) D(N) and precision p ⁡ ( N ) p(N) fail whenever D ⁡ ( N ) ​ 2 p ⁡ ( N ) = o ⁡ ( N ) D(N)2^{p(N)}=o(N) .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Copying under repetition requires distinguishing occurrences with the same content. Jelassi et al. (2024) construct a two-layer transformer that copies exponentially long strings by content-based n n -gram hashing, assuming no repeated n n -grams; their copying error measures the first L L output tokens. Our two-layer construction retrieves by anchor-relative position, allowing arbitrary repetition and including correct termination in the guarantee. Repetition also distinguishes easy and difficult copying tasks in studies of length generalization ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Huang et al. (2025) prove that Limit Transformers satisfying their Periodic and Local conditions cannot copy arbitrary strings. Our ECB lower bound instead quantifies layerwise saturation under finite-precision execution, independently of width.
blocks.zh: 重复复制需要区分内容相同的事件。 Jelassi 等 (2024) 构造出一个双层变压器,通过基于内容的n-gram散列来复制指数长字符串,假设没有重复的n-gram;其复制错误测量出第一个L L 输出符. 我们的两层建筑通过锚地相接位置回收,允许任意重复,并在担保中包括正确的终止. 重复在长度通论研究中也区分了简单而困难的复制任务(周等,2024. 黄等. (2025)证明,满足其周期性和局部条件的限制变换器不能复制任意字符串. 我们的欧洲央行的下限将分层饱和度量化 在有限的精确度下,独立于宽度。

blocks.en:
Positional encodings differ both in where they enter the computation and in how they represent position.
Value-side representations include the additive relative embeddings of Shaw et al. (2018) and the geometric transformations of GTA ( Miyato et al., 2024 ) . Su (2025) gives the VO-RoPE mechanism used here, applying opposite position-dependent rotations to values before aggregation and to outputs afterward to encode relative offsets. RoVE ( García-Castellanos et al., 2026 ) combines the same value/output rotation with query/key RoPE and studies it through an attentive-convolution interpretation and language-modeling experiments. ConveRT ( Henderson et al., 2020 ) uses learned absolute-position embeddings indexed by two coprime moduli. Our focus is on prime-period value rotations that encode anchor-relative offsets as modular residues, with explicit precision and head-count bounds for reliable copying ( Theorem 3.8 ).
blocks.zh:
位置编码在进入计算地点和如何代表位置上都有所不同.
值侧表示法包括Shaw等人(2018年)和GTA的几何变相(Miyato等人,2024年)的相加相对嵌入. Su (2025)给出了这里使用的VO-ROPE机制,对集合前的值和之后的输出进行相反的位置依赖旋转来编码相对抵消. RoVE(García-Castellanos等,2026年)将同值/输出旋转与查询/键 RoPE相结合,并通过细心的革命解释和语言模型实验来研究. ConveRT(Henderson等,2020年)使用由两个coprime moduli索引的已学习到的绝对位置嵌入. 我们的重点是将锚-相对相抵消编码为模块化残余物的正值旋转,明确精确度和人数界限,以便可靠地复制(定理3.8)。

blocks.en:
Expressivity results depend on which resources may grow with input length.
Circuit complexity bounds characterize transformer computation ( Merrill & Sabharwal, 2023 ; Strobl et al., 2024 ) , but the fixed-context next-token copy map already lies in DLOGTIME-uniform AC 0 \mathrm{AC}^{0} ( Appendix C ). Temporal-logic analyses characterize fixed-precision NoPE transformers and the effect of local attention ( Li & Cotterell, 2025 ; Li & Cotterell, 2026 ) , while length-generalization theory studies when bounded-length training suffices for unbounded-length correctness ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Our horizon-uniform framework asks how positional and computational resources must scale with a finite design horizon, requiring the same parameters to work across all source lengths within it.

blocks.en:
Under repetition, content matching need not distinguish the occurrence to copy next.
We study two ways positional information can reach the output: through attention weights over value vectors, or through position-dependent transformations of the values themselves.
The results establish failure for eventually-constant bias-only models under a specified finite-precision execution model, and sufficiency of a modular value-side construction for two-layer copying.
Appendix D gives the full execution model, architecture definitions, and proofs.

We first illustrate the repeated-content failures observed in frontier LLMs.
Our synthetic experiments then examine three questions about learning to copy: how standard positional baselines respond to repetition under a shared training distribution, whether a shallow model can learn to exploit VO-rotation, and where extrapolation occurs and how it breaks down beyond the product of the supplied prime periods.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Repetition makes content-based occurrence matching ambiguous and motivates
representing positions relative to delimiters.
VO-rotation writes anchor-relative offsets into the value stream. With
prime-period phases and CRT, a two-layer model copies arbitrary
strings throughout its design horizon, using the same retrieval rule for
copying and termination at O ⁡ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ N ) O(\log\log N) -bit precision.
The 𝒯 ECB \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{ECB}} lower bound identifies a width-independent
finite-precision obstruction: under the stated saturation condition, a model
cannot both finish a sufficiently long identical copy and terminate correctly.
In the synthetic experiments, two-layer VO models learn to copy with near-perfect
accuracy up to length 5000 5000 , 2.5 2.5 times the maximum training length.
On random and moderately repeated strings, their accuracy collapses just beyond
the period product 5005 5005 , as expected when offset residues collide.

We simulate FP8 forward passes by quantizing each linear layer’s input and weight, then returning both to their incoming storage dtypes before the linear operation.
Quantization uses PyTorch’s float8_e4m3fn cast without tensor-wise or channel-wise scaling or extra clipping, with fraction-bit truncation when the cast is unavailable. 3 3 3 The fallback retains the incoming exponent range and keeps three fraction bits for float32 / bfloat16 operands and one for float16 operands. We use straight-through gradients and retain master parameters, linear biases, and optimizer states at their original precision.
Accelerate selects CUDA autocast in bf16 when supported and fp16 otherwise.
Attention matrix products, softmax, residual updates, and layer normalization use native PyTorch mixed-precision arithmetic.
Position indices are integers, while phase multiplication and sine/cosine evaluation use float32 .

We use a sequential position generator to maintain each head’s rotation-table index with a cyclic counter c h , 0 = 0 c_{h,0}=0 , c h , t + 1 = ( c h , t + 1 ) mod q h c_{h,t+1}=(c_{h,t}+1)\bmod q_{h} .
Since q h = O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) q_{h}=O(\log N) , each counter uses O ⁡ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ N ) O(\log\log N) bits, within the construction’s precision scale; total counter state is O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) O(\log N) bits across heads.
The counter supplies the exact residue t mod q h t\bmod q_{h} for phase selection, as required by Definition 3.7 .
The phase values and rotation arithmetic are rounded to p p bits: Lemma D.13 bounds the total Layer-1 error by 8 ​ ε mach 8\varepsilon_{\mathrm{mach}} , and the Layer-2 gap analysis in ( 5 ) carries it through to the logits.
Head h h needs q h q_{h} sine/cosine pairs, giving O ⁡ ( log 2 ⁡ N / log ⁡ log ⁡ N ) O(\log^{2}N/\log\log N) stored scalars across heads, each rounded to p p bits.
The counters index these tables and depend only on position, while the attention computation selects the active anchor and forms its relative-offset fingerprint.
Table storage and counter state are accounted for separately from the precision of each stored coordinate.

Definition D.10 assigns one period per head, but distributing the residues across heads is a presentational choice, not a resource requirement.
Allowing different periods in different two-dimensional blocks of a single head implements the same computation: every prime head attends one-hot to the same active anchor, so a single head with the block-diagonal rotation diag ⁡ ( R q 1 , … , R q H ) \operatorname{diag}(R_{q_{1}},\ldots,R_{q_{H}}) reproduces all H H rotary outputs under the shared attention pattern, and Layer 2 already combines all prime blocks inside a single head via ( 2 ).
The resources can therefore equivalently be counted as a total rotary dimension of 2 ​ H 2H rather than a head count.
